# RectLight (UsdLux light)

A [UsdLux](glossary.md#usdlux) RectLight, a render-only light. It has no physics of its own: the parser, the [ovstage](glossary.md#ovstage) backend and usdLoad read none of its schema's attributes. It is a component only so the [compiled stage cache](glossary.md#compiled-stage-cache) does not bypass a Stage that contains it; its rows still enter the identity through the [structural columns](prim.md#columns), so a hit needs the same stage structure.

- **Transform columns:** yes, `Xformable`
- **No builder:** `ovphysx.population` and `Population.hpp` do not write this component; the consumer reads it when another population writes it.

## What USD population writes

Written by [USD](glossary.md#usd) population when a RENDERING description is populated beside the physics description (as [IsaacLab](glossary.md#isaaclab) populates), which keeps render prims; the physics description alone leaves it out.

## Notes

- Its built-in LightAPI carries CollectionAPI:lightLink and CollectionAPI:shadowLink; the parser reads a CollectionAPI only on a PhysicsCollisionGroup.
- As an ancestor of a physics [prim](glossary.md#prim) it composes its local transform like any Xformable, from the [prim block](prim.md#columns)'s transform columns.
